title: 第286章 恬不知耻第285章 再次教训房东
slug: 乡村大炮第296章先宣传一波
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：乡村大炮第一卷：默认第286章恬不知耻（..la）“好！”
“咬的好！”
“活该被咬！”
现场众人立即鼓掌叫好，大家早就看房东一家人不顺眼了，看到他们此刻被自己养的狗给咬了，那叫一个痛快。
“见鬼了。”
房东感觉后背冒凉气，怎么每次来这边，自家的狗就会发神经。
他痛得龇牙咧嘴，这一次被咬得更惨，感觉都要下不了床，走不了路，得在床上躺几个月。
他们最后被救护车给拉走了，至于几只狗，自然也被拉去处理。
“大炮，这是怎么回事？”颜思然问道。
“可能他们的狗也觉得他们太过分了。”李大炮开口忽悠。
“确实是有些过分，不过他们被咬的也挺惨的，接下来估计要养很久。”颜思然说道。
“这不是刚刚好吗？等他们养好了伤，刚好我们商城装修好了，就可以把超市搬过去了。”李大炮说道。
颜思然不置可否的点点头，看了一眼超市的现状，现在这个超市，确实已经无法满足他们日常经营需求，必须得要一个更大的超市。
“颜小姐，今天又有几个品牌商，想要跟我们谈谈产品入驻超市的事情。”
超市的经理过来汇报情况，现在他们超市的生意非常火爆，很多品牌都想入驻。
现在超市的生意已经越来越不好做，一大半的生意都已经被零食铺给抢走了。
那些和零食铺合作的品牌，自然是吃香的喝辣的。
但剩下那些没有和零食铺合作的品牌，感觉都快要被淘汰了。
“这些事情你去解决就行了。”
颜思然说道，当超市对产品的质量严格把控，只要质量过关，都可以入驻她的超市进行售卖。

“颜小姐，今天还来了一个零食铺的负责人，他们也想跟我们超市合作，这个你要不要见一见？”超市经理说道。
“行，那就见一见吧。”
颜思然答应下来，也不能把所有的事情都推给超市经理，她这个当老板娘的也得亲力亲为。
李大炮还没有走，跟着她一起见了一下这个零食铺的负责人。
“李总，颜小姐，二位好，自我介绍一下，我是小熊零食的区域经理，我姓戴。”
戴经理自我介绍，他是个戴着眼镜的中年男子，都干到经理了，还亲自出马，看样子对这个超市的生意很看重。
“戴经理，是不是生意不好做了？”
李大炮开口打趣，他们这种零食铺刚刚出现的时候，可以说是风靡一时，直接席卷各个城市，抢走了所有超市，便利店的生意。
但是现在风头过去了，大家也都清醒了，自然不会那么买账。

Recommended reading for all book friends: Country Cannon Volume 1: Default Chapter 286 Shameless (..la) "Okay!"
“Nice bite!”
"Deserves to be bitten!"
Everyone at the scene immediately clapped and applauded. Everyone had long disliked the landlord and his family, and they were so happy to see them being bitten by their own dog.
"What the hell."
The landlord felt a chill on his back. Why does his dog get nervous every time he comes here?
He grimaced in pain. This time, the bite was even worse. He felt like he couldn't get out of bed or walk. He had to lie in bed for several months.
They were eventually taken away by an ambulance, and naturally the dogs were also taken away for treatment.
"Cannon, what's going on?" Yan Siran asked.
"Maybe their dogs also think they are going too far." Li Dapao said to fool him.
"It is indeed a bit excessive, but they were bitten quite badly, and they will probably need to be raised for a long time." Yan Siran said.
"Isn't this just right? When they recover from their injuries and our mall is renovated, we can move the supermarket there." Li Dapao said.
Yan Siran nodded noncommittally and took a look at the current situation of the supermarket. The current supermarket was indeed unable to meet their daily business needs, and a larger supermarket was necessary.
"Ms. Yan, there are several brand owners today who want to talk to us about putting their products in supermarkets."
The manager of the supermarket came over to report the situation. The business in their supermarket is now very booming, and many brands want to enter.
Nowadays, supermarket business has become increasingly difficult, and most of the business has been taken away by snack shops.
Those brands that cooperate with snack shops are naturally popular for their spicy drinks.
But the remaining brands that have not cooperated with snack shops feel that they are about to be eliminated.
"You just have to deal with these things."
Yan Siran said that when supermarkets strictly control the quality of products, as long as they pass the quality standard, they can be sold in her supermarket.
"Miss Yan, the person in charge of a snack shop came here today. They also want to cooperate with our supermarket. Do you want to meet this?" the supermarket manager said.
"Okay, let's meet."
After Yan Siran agreed, she couldn't leave everything to the supermarket manager. As the boss's wife, she had to do it herself.
Li Dapao hadn't left yet and followed her to meet with the person in charge of the snack shop.
"Mr. Li, Miss Yan, hello, please introduce yourself. I am the regional manager of Little Bear Snacks. My surname is Dai."
Manager Dai introduced himself. He was a middle-aged man wearing glasses. He had become a manager. He also took action personally. He seemed to value the supermarket's business very much.
"Manager Dai, is business going bad?"
Li Dapao joked that when snack shops like theirs first appeared, it could be said to be all the rage, sweeping across cities and taking away the business of all supermarkets and convenience stores.
But now that the limelight has passed and everyone is awake, naturally they won’t buy it so much.
